reviewed_by: V12.4 evidence and Portuguese editorial review

source_notes.regulatory_scope: RDC 907/2024, arts. 5, 8, 9, 12: substantiation and no misleading/therapeutic labeling. This library is not Anvisa authorization or proof of Brazilian product regularization.
source_notes.packaging: Exact owner-supplied purple 7-sheet pouch photograph and approved master; no green CX or 28-sheet benefit transfer. Existing physical award-mark permission is unchanged.
source_notes.scientific_context: Ingredient context is not used as finished-product clinical evidence. No independent exact-product trial dossier established; no efficacy extrapolation.
source_notes.language_review: Natural pt-BR editorial assessment; not represented as an independent human native-speaker certification. Owner review of the complete library and planned briefs remains pending.
source_notes.human_origin_assessment: Consolidated RDC 529/2021 Annex entry 416 lists cells, tissues and human-origin products. Manufacturer declares human adipose-derived exosomes. Exact-product Brazilian assessment/regularization is not established. All Brazil creative readiness remains held even after owner copy approval; no definitive legal ruling on the individual SKU is asserted here.
